pricingEvidence.evidence: Web search summary: "Claude Code pricing is bundled into Claude Pro ($20/month), Max 5x ($100/month), Max 20x ($200/month), Team and enterprise plans, or pay-as-you-go API… Claude Code is included in all paid plans… at no additional charge."

sources.title: Claude Code pricing: all plans and real costs (Sept 2026)

has_free_tier.note: Included in paid Claude plans or billed via the API; no free plan mentioned in the sources.

nl.tagline: Anthropic's coding agent voor terminal en editor
nl.description: Claude Code is een programmeeragent die in je terminal, editor of browser werkt: hij leest je codebase, voert opdrachten uit, schrijft en test code en maakt commits of pull requests. Inbegrepen bij betaalde Claude-abonnementen of af te rekenen via de API.
bestFor: Ontwikkelaars die complete taken willen delegeren
limitations: Deelt de gebruikslimieten van je Claude-abonnement

en.tagline: Anthropic's coding agent for terminal and editor
en.description: Claude Code is a coding agent that works in your terminal, editor or browser: it reads your codebase, runs commands, writes and tests code and makes commits or pull requests. Included with paid Claude plans or billed through the API.
limitations: Shares the usage limits of your Claude plan
